api: public kill: mut self -> Result<Unit, Text> uses Process
invariants: kill exclusively borrows rather than consumes the affine Child owner
kill requests forced termination without waiting, reaping, closing, or clearing the native token
tryWait or wait remains the single terminal-observation and reap authority
a cached terminal Child makes kill an idempotent successful no-op
Windows requests TerminateProcess and Linux requests SIGKILL
an invalid token or operating-system rejection returns Err(kill)
